text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After class, I see Super Creek and Rice Shower wearing costumes in the classroom…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I thought as much. Lowering the lights in the dorm would be dangerous. Hmm…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, y-yes… I think so, too

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. ♪ We're making arrangements for the Cross-Dorm Dare-Off. Rice and I make up the executive committee.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: We've finished with the costume fitting, so now we're organizing the tests of courage.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Coming up with interesting ideas has been surprisingly tough, though…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah… I don't think I'm very good with scary stuff…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Well, let's note down everything we've come up with so far.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: …Oh? That's a little odd. The lead's not coming out of my mechanical pencil.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: W-well, I can make a memo on my phone so—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …Hm? Why can't I turn it on?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ngh… It's happening again! I've brought more bad luck!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry, Creek. I knew it was a bad idea to have me on the Dare-Off Committee…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Now, now. Don't say things like that. You haven't done anything wrong.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: It's ghosts that are to blame for these mishaps! They saw our costumes, thought we were friends of theirs, and floated on over.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh? Ghosts? B-but those aren't…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: There! Can't you feel it? I can sense a spook getting closer as we speak…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Swish…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eek! My leg! Is that… a ghost?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's actually just Super Creek brushing her tail across Rice Shower's leg, but…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: It seems like this ghost is partial to pranks, don't you think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It sounds like she wants me to play along. I'll try shaking the desk without Rice Shower noticing it's me!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: AAH! The desk is shaking?! Wh-wh-what should we do, Creek?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Don't fret, it's all right. I'll keep you safe and sound.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Listen to me, you… silly spookster! Scaring Rice is a big no-no!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …It's gone quiet. Did the ghost… leave?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yep! I've chased it right off.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But… wh-what if it comes back?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Then I'll chase it off again! As many times as I have to. I'll keep you perfectly safe!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: So don't you worry about it, and let's get on with our committee meeting. Okay, Rice? ♪
choice_data_list: I think you'll both do fine!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: So don't you worry about it, and let's get on with our committee meeting. Okay, Rice? ♪
choice_data_list: I think you'll both do fine!
I think you'll both do fine!
If you get spooked again, you can let Creek look after you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Just leave everything to this Mummy. ♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …Um, I tend to get frightened easily, so I'm not sure I'll be able to perform my duties too well, but…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'll try my very best to make sure the Dare-Off is fun for everyone!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Absolutely. I know you can do it, Rice. You already overcame your fears today. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterwards, they both go on to have an amazing exchange of ideas, making for a very successful planning meeting!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: That's right! I'll coddle you good and proper. ♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, a-actually, I'm still a little… frightened, so…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: There, there. Don't you worry now. "Mummy" is right here with you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: …Oh, and I'm happy to coddle you as well, Trainer. That's what "mummies" are for, after all. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the Dare-Off planning meeting continues with Super Creek providing copious amounts of coddling.
